ValidationRule.description: SFM-5169 Make "Onboarding Contact" Required at Onboarding Handoff for CSAT - 12.19.2022
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.ValidationSetting__c.ByPassAllValidationRules__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Onboarding", ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed"), ISBLANK( ContactId ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to close an onboarding case with a blank Contact. Please update the Contact Name to the correct contact.
